rationale: The replication successfully demonstrates the existence and stabilization of the pyrochlore AF* state with its defining characteristics (gapped deconfined spinons, gapless U(1) photon, AAO order), reproduces the correct phase sequence (U(1) QSL → AF* → fragmented AFM), and confirms the spinon condensation mechanism at the AF*-to-fragmented-AFM boundary. However, the work uses an effective single-parameter (t2) scan rather than solving the full self-consistent mean-field equations in the paper's (J̃⊥/J̃x, J2xz/J̃x) parameter space, and no quantitative comparison of phase boundaries is possible due to lack of extractable figure data. Strong qualitative agreement but incomplete quantitative verification justifies PARTIAL.
